one_month_reasoning: Inside the window: Q3 FY27 results and the Q4 guide on 2026-12-01 (revenue already pre-announced in line on 11-02, so the surprise is the Q4 guide and FY28 commentary after the investor day's ~$20B); the S-4 for the Lumentum deal; the Fed's December meeting; continued AI-sector flows after NVIDIA's CEO exit and the midterm-driven sell-off. The stock fell 51% from $251.65 (10-28) to $122.28 in 17 sessions with -11.7% on the last day; short-horizon reversal after such moves is modest and momentum is negative, and MRVL has sold off after in-line prints before (Aug 2026). I stay near neutral: lognormal centred at $122.5 with monthly sigma 24.5% (86% / 3.5), giving P(>= $122.28) = 0.50.

fair_value.method: P/E 17.6x (peer median 15.7x shrunk toward MRVL's own 18.1x at k=0.8) on the build's NTM non-GAAP EPS at the horizon (~$7.85; FY28 $6.62, FY29 $8.15), less a probability-weighted Lumentum dilution (-$2.8/share).

methods.name: P/E
methods.inputs: NTM EPS at 2027-11-20 from the quarter build (revenue FY28 $17.5B, FY29 $21.6B; non-GAAP op margin ~39-40%; tax 11%) x 17.6x; Lumentum adjustment -$5.2B x 0.5

inputs_detail.derivation: Annual totals from the standing file's base case (MRVL FY2026 ~ CY2025 ... FY2029 ~ CY2028; Marvell's fiscal year ends late January). Quarters: a monotone cubic (PCHIP) on cumulative capex at year ends 0/410/1,143/2,223/3,553 gives quarterly values that sum exactly to each year; the CY2025 split (79.8/95.4/110.3/124.6) lands within ~4% of the companies' reported quarters, so the actual quarters are labelled estimates (flag: quarterly hyperscaler actuals were not re-sourced in this pass). Other builds: total AI capex ex-China (file: 1,225/1,841/2,255) gives the same 2027 growth (+50% vs +47%) and 2028 (+22% vs +23%); low case 720/880/800 and high 750/1,360/1,750 drive the downside/upside.
inputs_detail.variant_view: Low case (2027 $880B, 2028 $800B) cuts the research target (12m) by roughly a third; high case adds about as much (downside/upside cases).

inputs_detail.derivation: Actual: FY26 Q1-Q4 1.81%/1.56%/1.38%/1.33%, FY27 Q1 1.24%, Q2 1.24% (DC $M / capex $B / 1000). Q3 FY27 1.35% = DC $2,656M (management guided DC growth of roughly 75% y/y on Q3 FY26 $1,517.9M per Trefis 2026-11-17) / 197.2. Q4 FY27 1.40%: custom programs ramp in H2 FY27 (Futurum 2026-09-01) and the CEO said revenue growth accelerates each quarter of FY27 (Q1 FY27 release); 1.40% gives Q4 revenue +57% y/y vs Q3 +52%. FY28 1.40-1.45%: custom revenue 'more than doubling' in FY28 (management via Futurum) on top of merchant DC tracking capex; FY28 DC +60% vs capex +47%. FY29 1.45-1.48%: custom >$12B FY29 target (Will Chu, investor day) taken only partly (base-rate conservatism, Google shifting some custom work to MediaTek per 24/7 Wall St 2026-11-20); FY29 DC +26% vs capex +23%. Alternatives: (a) consensus FY28 revenue $19.84B (StockAnalysis 2026-11-20) implies capture ~1.63%; (b) investor-day FY28 ~$20B implies ~1.65%; (c) capture held at the Q3 FY27 level 1.35% (FY28 DC ~$14.6B); (d) the 2025 decline (1.81% -> 1.33%) resuming as GPU/TPU share rises.
inputs_detail.variant_view: Consensus-implied capture (~1.63% FY28) would add ~+15% to the research target (12m); capture held at 1.35% takes ~-5%.

inputs_detail.derivation: Company's non-GAAP rate 11.0% in Q1 and Q2 FY27 (10% FY26); kept at the stated rate.

inputs_detail.derivation: Peer median NTM P/E 15.68x (7 peers, 2026-11-20 closes / current consensus); MRVL own 18.12x (122.28 / 6.75); exit = 15.68 x (18.12/15.68)^0.8 = 17.60x. Alternatives: peer median exactly (15.7x, ~-11%); MRVL's pre-deal own multiple (~33x at $251.65 on 7.6 NTM EPS, a top-of-cycle reading); 12.2x (CRDO) in the downside.
inputs_detail.variant_view: each 1x turn moves the research target (12m) ~$7.7

inputs_detail.derivation: equity-level $M. If the deal is on track at the horizon, MRVL holders own 67% of MRVL + LITE + synergies instead of 100% of MRVL. Standalone MRVL equity at the horizon (engine base, ~$128B) ; LITE equity $45.9B (= $460.54 x 90.5M diluted shares, $41.7B at the 2026-11-20 close, +10% to the horizon; 90.5M = $102.5B deal equity / $1,132); synergies $9.4B (= $1B run-rate x (1 - 11% tax) x 17.6x x 60% realization/phase-in). 0.67 x (128 + 45.9 + 9.4) - 128 = -5.2B. Probability 0.5 = merger-arb implied odds (Bloomberg 2026-11-09). Variant: LITE valued at the peer NTM P/E on growth like COHR's gives a ~+$3B transfer instead; a break could cost a fee of 'several billion' either way.
inputs_detail.variant_view: LITE at a growth multiple like COHR's: ~+$3B transfer (+$1.6/share at 0.5); deal renegotiated at a higher ratio: worse.

inputs_detail.derivation: average of FY25 28.9% and FY26 35.3% (Q4 FY26 release non-GAAP op income), the last trough-to-recovery pair

downside.story: P10: AI capex digestion: Big-4 capex on the standing file's low path (2027 $880B, 2028 $800B, about -25% vs base over FY28-29), MRVL loses custom share (Google's MediaTek shift repeated at AWS/Microsoft), GM -1.5pt on lower utilisation and custom pricing; the exit P/E falls to ~12x (CRDO/COHR today; NVDA trades 8x). Recession odds 21% (Kalshi-style 2027 market) and data-center moratorium pledges after the midterms make this a 1-in-10 outcome, not a tail.

base.story: Big-4 capex on the standing base path (+47% in 2027, +23% in 2028); MRVL DC grows +60% in FY28 and +26% in FY29 as custom programs ramp, revenue $17.5B / $21.6B (12% below FY28 consensus), op margin ~39-40%, NTM EPS ~$7.85 at the horizon x 17.6x; Lumentum still pending with ~50% odds and a small dilution.

upside.story: P90: capex on the standing file's high path (2027 $1,360B, 2028 $1,750B), custom programs reach the investor-day trajectory (>$12B FY29), GM holds the H2 FY27 range, and the multiple re-rates to ~24.6x (ALAB/AMD today, where MRVL traded before the deal) as deal fears fade.

reasoning: Base rates first: MRVL's five earlier 45%+ drawdowns from a 12-month high since 2007 (2008-10, 2012-10, 2015-10, 2022-06, 2025-03; Twelve Data monthly closes) were followed by +37% to +97% 12-month returns (median ~+59%), but the 2000-01 bust shows a -50% stock can halve again, and this drawdown has a fundamental trigger (an all-stock $115B deal giving away 33% of the company) plus a macro one (midterm-driven AI sell-off, NVIDIA CEO exit, Google shifting custom work to MediaTek). Stock-financed acquirers earned -25% five-year excess returns (Loughran-Vijh 1997) and merger arbs price ~50% closing odds, so I book a small probability-weighted dilution (-$2.8/share). Kalshi-style 2027 recession odds are 21%. The driver build ties DC revenue to the standing AI-capex base (Big-4 $1,080B in 2027, $1,330B in 2028) with a capture term fitted on six reported quarters (1.24-1.81%) and lifted modestly for the custom ramp; FY28 revenue $17.5B and EPS ~$6.6 are 12% / 10% below consensus ($19.84B / $7.37, StockAnalysis 2026-11-20), deliberately conservative (rule 0c) because the investor-day target was set at the sentiment peak. Peers' NTM P/Es were rebuilt on 2026-11-20 closes (peer table snapshot stale): median 15.7x; exit 17.6x at k = 0.8. Research target (12m) $135.37 (+11%); P10 $55.8 (capex low path, share loss, ~13x), P90 $281 (capex high path, custom on plan, ~24.6x). Research was limited to ~25 searches/fetches; several sell-side and consensus pages (Zacks, MarketBeat, Chartmill, Nasdaq API) were unreachable.

Q3 FY27 1.35% = DC $2,656M (management guided DC growth of roughly 75% y/y on Q3 FY26 $1,517.9M per Trefis 2026-11-17) / 197.2. Q4 FY27 1.40%: custom programs ramp in H2 FY27 (Futurum 2026-09-01) and the CEO said revenue growth accelerates each quarter of FY27 (Q1 FY27 release); 1.40% gives Q4 revenue +57% y/y vs Q3 +52%. adjustments.name: Lumentum all-stock deal: value transfer if it is still expected to close
adjustments.note: equity-level $M. If the deal is on track at the horizon, MRVL holders own 67% of MRVL + LITE + synergies instead of 100% of MRVL. Standalone MRVL equity at the horizon (engine base, ~$128B) ; LITE equity $45.9B (= $460.54 x 90.5M diluted shares, $41.7B at the 2026-11-20 close, +10% to the horizon; 90.5M = $102.5B deal equity / $1,132); synergies $9.4B (= $1B run-rate x (1 - 11% tax) x 17.6x x 60% realization/phase-in). 0.67 x (128 + 45.9 + 9.4) - 128 = -5.2B. Probability 0.5 = merger-arb implied odds (Bloomberg 2026-11-09). Variant: LITE valued at the peer NTM P/E on growth like COHR's gives a ~+$3B transfer instead; a break could cost a fee of 'several billion' either way.

downside.story: P10: AI capex digestion: Big-4 capex on the standing file's low path (2027 $880B, 2028 $800B, about -25% vs base over FY28-29), MRVL loses custom share (Google's MediaTek shift repeated at AWS/Microsoft), GM -1.5pt on lower utilisation and custom pricing; the exit P/E falls to ~12x (CRDO/COHR today; NVDA trades 8x). Recession odds 21% (Kalshi-style 2027 market) and data-center moratorium pledges after the midterms make this a 1-in-10 outcome, not a tail.

upside.story: P90: capex on the standing file's high path (2027 $1,360B, 2028 $1,750B), custom programs reach the investor-day trajectory (>$12B FY29), GM holds the H2 FY27 range, and the multiple re-rates to ~24.6x (ALAB/AMD today, where MRVL traded before the deal) as deal fears fade.

model_inputs.structure_note: Quarterly driver-led set: revenue = Big-4 AI capex (standing file) x MRVL data-center capture + communications revenue; adjusted EBIT = revenue x non-GAAP GM - non-GAAP opex; interest and interest income as their own quarter lines (rule 29).
